summary: Iteration 5 — End-to-end validation of the new Odoo-parity changes (Custom Fields drag-drop builder, Lead Detail typed inputs, multi-action Automations, Facebook Lead Ads tab + webhook). Backend: re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_changes.py → 6/6 PASS (field types/reorder, multi-action automations, FB verify/signature/test-lead/status). Frontend (admin@homeivf.com): all four cases verified via Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. (1) CUSTOM FIELDS: form-builder + components-palette + section-dropzone-qa + section-dropzone-general all present; all 9 palette items render (palette-char/text/integer/float/monetary/date/datetime/boolean/selection); click-to-add Date and Dropdown both opened add-field-modal, persisted with field-label-input + field-section-select + field-options-input (only on selection type) + field-create-submit, and rendered field-card-<id> in section-fields-general. (2) LEAD DETAIL: opened real lead id=500045 (the FB-created one) → custom-fields-card renders the newly created field, custom-fields-edit-button opens edit mode, custom-field-input-x_custom_qa2_date is a real <input type="date">, save persists & custom-field-value-x_custom_qa2_date shows '2026-01-15'. (3) AUTOMATIONS: add-automation-button → automation-modal opens with action-row-0; trigger options include on_create; action-type-0 supports add_tag/set_lead_stage/send_whatsapp_template/send_email_template/assign_user; add-action-row creates action-row-1; submit returned 'Automation created' toast and both rules (id=17 QA Multi Action Rule, id=18 QA2 Rule) appeared in automations-list with 'Trigger: on_create → add_tag, set_lead_stage'. (4) FACEBOOK: facebook-tab + fb-callback-url ('https://homeivf-crm-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api/webhooks/facebook') + all config inputs (app_id/app_secret/page_id/page_access_token/verify_token/graph_api_version) + fb-save-button + fb-subscribe-button + fb-mapping-list + fb-add-map + fb-save-mapping + fb-send-test all rendered; saved verify_token='QA_VERIFY_TOKEN_123'; added mapping fbname=full_name → crm=contact_name (Save mapping → toast); fb-send-test posted to /api/admin/facebook/test → 200 with lead_id=500045 (real lead created, name='QA FB Lead', tags=[56], stage='Contact Attempt', source_lead='Meta Lead Ads', ads_platform='Facebook' — confirms mapping mapped full_name→contact_name).

ui_bugs.issue: Each rule row in automations-list is missing a data-testid (only admin-tab-automations, add-automation-button, automations-list are present). The review-request expected data-testid='automation-rule-<id>' per row plus a delete-icon testid (e.g. automation-delete-<id>). Functionality works (toast 'Automation created', rule appears with trigger summary, ACTIVE badge + trash button visible) but per-row automation is hard to target in tests/UI automation.

Trash button on a field card performs a SOFT-DELETE (field moves into a 'Disabled Fields' chip strip with '<label> · enable' actions) instead of hard-delete. There is also no DELETE endpoint exposed (GET /api/admin/custom-fields returns 404 — list endpoint isn't reachable via this path). Soft-delete is fine for product UX, but for E2E/test cleanup there is no way for the test agent to hard-purge created fields — leaves dummy 'Disabled Fields' entries (QA Test Field, QA Test Dropdown, QA2 Date). Suggest exposing GET /api/admin/custom-fields + a DELETE …?hard=true (or making the disable-chip's other action a real delete).

Per-row testids fb-test-row-0/1/2 not rendered as wrappers; only the inner fb-test-name-N/fb-test-value-N inputs exist. fb-send-test still works correctly (POSTs to /api/admin/facebook/test → 200), but the wrapper row testid the spec mentioned is missing.

React hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' Inside one of the CRM-field <select>s in the mapping rows. Cosmetic, but worth fixing — wrap option labels as plain text only.

action_items: PURGE QA leftovers — main agent must clean these up at the DB/code level (UI cannot delete them):

• Lead id=500045 ('QA FB Lead', phone 9999000111, email qa.fb@example.com) — DELETE /api/leads/500045 returns 405 (no delete route). Main agent: db.leads.delete_one({id:500045}) or expose hard-delete.

• Custom fields created during E2E (now in 'Disabled Fields'): ids 25 (QA Test Field, date), 26 (QA Test Dropdown, selection), 27 (QA2 Date, date). DELETE /api/custom-fields/<id> and /api/admin/custom-fields/<id> both 404 — main agent: db.custom_fields.delete_many({label:{$in:['QA Test Field','QA Test Dropdown','QA2 Date']}}).
• Both QA automation rules (id=17 QA Multi Action Rule, id=18 QA2 Rule) were successfully removed via DELETE /api/admin/automations/<id> (200). No DB cleanup needed.
ADD per-row data-testid to AutomationsTab rule cards: data-testid='automation-rule-<id>' on the row + 'automation-delete-<id>' on the trash icon (review-spec requirement).
ADD wrapper data-testid='fb-test-row-<i>' to FacebookTab test-lead rows (spec mentioned fb-test-rows wrappers).
Fix hydration warning by ensuring mapping <select><option> contains text only — no <span> children inside <option>.
(Optional UX) Surface a hard-delete affordance on field cards in the form-builder so QA / admins can fully purge unused custom fields beyond soft-disable.
critical_code_review_comments: CASE 1 form-builder is rock-solid — click-to-add works for ALL palette types we tested, options input correctly appears only for selection type, section dropdown correctly defaults; field-card-<id> testids are emitted for downstream tests. ✓

CASE 2 typed field rendering: confirmed that x_custom_<key> fields are emitted into the lead detail; <input type='date'> is used (not browser-default text input), Dropdown renders <select>, Save persists. This is exactly the Odoo-Studio parity behavior. ✓

CASE 3 backend correctly accepts and persists multi-action arrays (verified via /api/admin/automations GET — both rules show action_type list). Frontend list row, however, is missing per-row data-testid (see ui_bugs). ✓ (with UI testid gap)

CASE 4 /api/admin/facebook/test correctly simulates a leadgen webhook locally (no Meta call) and proves the field mapping pipeline end-to-end — the response lead.tags=[56], lead_stage='Contact Attempt' (from the rule we created!), source_lead='Meta Lead Ads' confirm the automation engine fires on Meta-sourced leads. Powerful integration test. ✓

Soft-delete semantics for custom fields ('Disabled Fields' chip strip) is good UX (preserves historic lead values) but should be paired with an admin-only hard-purge for QA hygiene. Main agent to decide.
Hydration warning from <option> > <span> nesting is the only console error we observed across the four flows — cheap to fix.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional — all 4 cases pass core flows; 4 cosmetic/testid gaps logged
